meta.purpose: Content-set receipt and bounded disposition map for the preserved React Corpus report directory. This registry proves inventory coverage, not the truth of every report claim or candidate row.

evidence_snapshot.label: react_corpus_reports_2026_09_08
evidence_snapshot.set_identity_algorithm: Sort normalized relative paths ordinally; for each file append path, TAB, byte length, TAB, lowercase SHA-256, LF; SHA-256 the UTF-8 concatenation.

read_receipt.boundary: Reading, hashing and structural indexing establish complete report-set coverage. They do not promote report prose, summary percentages, candidate inventories or generated fixture exports into product truth.

post_snapshot_derived_evidence.boundary: These files were generated after the immutable 2026-09-08 preserved-input snapshot. They are individually hash-bound derived/review outputs and are excluded only from reconstruction of that older input-set identity; they remain mandatory when external evidence validation is requested, while their own truth boundaries determine semantic authority.

evidence_quality_findings.evidence: MASTER_MANUAL_ADJUDICATION_MATRIX.json contains 360 case objects while total_cases says 334; observed row categories and summary confusion counts disagree, with blank or missing core fields in a material subset.
evidence_quality_findings.consequence: Do not publish aggregate precision, recall or accuracy from the stored summary until row identities and denominators are reconciled.

evidence_quality_findings.evidence: SAGE_FIX_FIXTURES.json carries review context but lacks a uniform executable expected-verdict contract; many contexts are file-head fallbacks that do not bind the reported predicate.
evidence_quality_findings.consequence: Promote selected cases only after exact source/evaluator identity, triggering snippet, positive control, negative control and expected output are bound.

evidence_quality_findings.evidence: The latest candidate inventory contains 166180 UNREVIEWED records; 160216 remain source-and-lineage verification pending and 5964 retain recorded blockers.
evidence_quality_findings.consequence: Candidate volume is a review queue, not a defect count or implementation mandate.

evidence_quality_findings.evidence: evidence_map029 maps 210 review units into 16 families and 113 subgroups, but records implementation_ready_groups as 0 and preserves unresolved decision axes.
evidence_quality_findings.consequence: Use paired executable counterexamples to promote narrow repairs; do not bulk-convert the 113 subgroups into v1.0.5 code changes.

evidence_quality_findings.evidence: README and synthesis reports contain stale or stronger completion/count language than their underlying matrices and later evidence maps support.
evidence_quality_findings.consequence: Registry, source-bound tests and validators outrank narrative completion or quality percentages.

disposition_policy.promotion_rule: A bounded_v1_0_5_candidate becomes implementation work only after a current-source producer/consumer trace and at least one triggering plus one non-triggering executable control. Repository names and paths cannot become product exceptions.
disposition_policy.release_rule: v1.0.5 cannot enter release proof while this registry has an undispositioned family or a confirmed v1.0.5 repair lacks its focused validation and semantic review. Existing roadmap work does not silently become a v1.0.5 blocker.
disposition_policy.unknown_rule: Insufficient, unresolved, design-choice and policy-dependent evidence remains explicit; it is not coerced into TP, FP, TN or FN.

family_dispositions.decision: Reconcile row/count semantics and promote only source-bound contrasts. No global quality percentage is release evidence.
Preserve the policy-owned full/deep profile repair and bounded producer-selection regressions; missing historical artifacts retain per-run attribution.
Preserve generalized target SQLite-first and present-empty versus missing/invalid consumer behavior; no Payload-specific branch.
Require same-binding JSX instantiation, not uppercase declaration or ordinary invocation alone.
Evaluate count/plural evidence per executable translation call and preserve unknown textual placeholders.
Resolve returned cleanup producers in executable effect scope while retaining true dangling-resource findings.

v1.0.5 now parses complete top-level JSX attributes, accepts boolean readOnly/disabled, hidden serialization and explicit custom-control event ownership, and retains the unmanaged editable-control positive. Unobserved headless-library runtime behavior remains UNKNOWN under the 1.1.0 context-authority owner rather than becoming a path exception.

v1.0.5 distinguishes direct object-literal key ownership from provider member calls, delegated options and dynamic keys, while retaining direct keyless-query and mutation invalidation findings. Mutation-owned onError and pending contracts satisfy async wrappers; provider behavior not evidenced statically remains with the 1.1.0 context-authority owner.

v1.0.5 binds hydration checks to hydratable production source, excludes test/React Email and non-React TypeScript surfaces, requires actual JSX action binding, and separates feature evaluation from telemetry or comment/string lookalikes. Broader execution-context inference remains a 1.1.0 evidence-authority concern.

v1.0.5 limits hook/ref/async parsing to executable call surfaces, masks comment/string lookalikes, respects callback-parameter shadowing, and preserves paired imperative-handle and async-handler positives. Framework runtime semantics not proven by source remain UNKNOWN under the 1.1.0 context-authority owner.

v1.0.5 uses balanced rendered-JSX map snippets, retains missing and index-key positives, removes list-count-only virtualization obligations and excludes static document renderers. The preserved long multiline-key claim did not reproduce, so no repository-specific exception was added.
Require duplicated editable ownership or measured provider blast radius; coexistence of URL, cache, form and local UI state is not itself a defect.
Preserve verified accessible error mappings while making custom form ownership and design-token policy applicability target-native and evidence-bound.
Model actual React lazy calls, route roles and hierarchical loading/error boundaries; static generation and API handlers need distinct applicability.
Ingest effective per-file policy without executing untrusted configs. Repository rules inform applicability; they do not override SAGE evidence honesty or security invariants.
Trace every claimed zero-hit rule through doctrine, tags, imports and dispatch with paired controls. Zero observations do not prove dead code or authorize deletion.
Require frozen acquisition, project-scope and Atlas/source identities before diagnosing current path or topology behavior; do not reopen delivered repository-scope work without a counterexample.
Separate discovery, sequencing, installation and engine budgets. Do not adopt file_count/50, persistent workers or DAG parallelism without measured causal evidence and interruption controls.
Preserve UNKNOWN for absent required evidence and reject uncalibrated weights or accuracy claims. Correct source/report connectivity before changing score mathematics.
Keep save-pulse work distinct from explicit final-governance closure and require an expanding receipt before changing cost policy.
Server-action auth, waterfall, pooling, cache-collision and safe-remediation claims need runtime or framework contracts. Findings do not authorize automatic source mutation.
Treat compiler readiness, provider churn and longitudinal erosion as bounded observations until source identities, denominators and causal comparisons support a product rule or public claim.

completion_boundary.release_readiness_claim: All bounded v1.0.5 family candidates retain explicit outcomes and the centrally registered v1.0.6 release blockers are technically ready_for_delivery. This does not adjudicate 166180 candidate rows, repair historical aggregate percentages, authorize a broad Corpus replay, satisfy projected-public Linux evidence, or prove release shipment.
completion_boundary.next_action: Preserve the completed Corpus disposition evidence while the technically ready v1.0.6 work crosses its separately governed clean, public-projection and Linux delivery boundaries. Native-linter execution, new cage/runtime capabilities and broad Corpus replay remain outside this closure.
